content.comment_body: Hello, I plan to measure and show temperatures at two separate locations using [product_name] base module [article_no], an [product_name] expansion module [article_no], and two PT100 sensors. The sensors are connected to I1-U1 and I2-U2. Since they are two-wire sensors, I also connected I1-M1 and I2-M2 as advised. I am having trouble programming this setup in [product_name] software and would appreciate advice on how to get started, as I am new to the system.

[article_no]? That is a digital expansion module. Did you mean [article_no]? That module supports PT100/1000 sensors (AM2 RTD). Your description of wiring with I1 - U1 and I2 - U2 suggests you're using an AM2 module for voltage and current measurement. Can you clarify which module you actually have?
Apologies for the confusion; I do have the correct module with the D. I copied the model name and I/O labels from online sources and missed the difference.

Here is the wiring diagram for the AM2 RTD. By default, the main module reserves the first two analog input addresses (AI1 and AI2). If no additional expansion modules are connected, the AM2 RTD will then use AI3 and AI4.
